name: AC Barber Studio
tagline: Classic cuts and modern fades on North La Salle Street in Navasota.
about: AC Barber Studio at 912 N La Salle St, Suite D, does classic cuts and modern fades, with walk-ins welcome.
In August 2024 the shop gave away free haircuts and school supplies to Grimes County kids.
